frases.texto: If you've ever been to Miami, GTA six is going to look familiar.
frases.estilo: Direct and complicit, like starting a chat.

frases.texto: The game's city is called Vice City, and according to the press and Rockstar interviews, it's inspired by Miami.
And the state where it all happens, Leonida, is inspired by Florida, according to media reports.
Reporters in Miami compared the trailer to the real city.
According to Miami New Times, the Venetian Causeway, the bridge linking Miami and Miami Beach, shows up recreated in the game.
Heads up: as far as we know, Rockstar hasn't confirmed which specific places are real. These are trailer comparisons.
Its official site calls Vice City the darkest side of the sunniest place in America, without naming Miami.
If you've already played it, see if any street feels familiar.
Send this to your friend from Florida.
